name: The Best Frozen Strawberry Daiquiri

instructions.primary_message: Quarter the ripe strawberries, then remove the leaves.

At least 8 hours before you plan to serve the drink, add rum, 21 g lime juice, and 21 g turbinado simple syrup to a resealable container or zipper-lock bag. Place batched mix in the freezer until freezer-cold, about 8 hours.

When ready to serve, add quartered strawberries to blender. Add chilled cocktail mix, pinch salt, and 8 ice cubes. Pulse blender 5 times, then blend until uniform. Taste and add up to 7 g additional turbinado simple syrup as needed. Blend once more briefly and serve immediately, with a lime wheel, strawberry, and/or straw, if desired.

If you want to make multiple drinks, you can pre-batch up to a double recipe (a blender may not hold much more than that easily) in a single container, add 14 ice cubes, then divide after blending; if making more than two drinks, use separate containers to hold more servings.

schema_metadata.keywords: blender, cocktail, daiquiri, drink, frozen cocktail, rum

description: This cocktail features fresh strawberries that get thrown in the blender with a super-chilled rum-lime-sugar mix. The result has a more intense flavor and stays slushy and cold.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 8 hr 5 min.

Optional or for serving: Lime wheel, strawberry, and/or straw, for garnish (optional)

Notes: To make turbinado simple syrup, combine equal volumes of turbinado sugar, such as Sugar in the Raw, and hot water in a tight-fitting resealable container such as a mason jar. Shake vigorously until sugar is completely dissolved; extra simple syrup can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to one month.
author: Maggie Hoffman
